answer: A dormant sybil swarm hides as a diffuse nebula until payout, then wakes to vote as one. I defend with unpredictable liveness: a beacon pulse seeded by unforeseeable randomness demands each identity answer inside a tight window, stamping its reply with a distinct pigment no sibling can reuse. One operator cannot keep thousands of identities awake and uniquely responsive to every pulse, so the swarm thins to the few genuinely live agents.
